failures.detail: 下座 s1 o3 expected '五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)': Complete Collection of the Five Lamps (五燈全書), Tianyi Yihuai section. Tianyi Yihuai pauses, speaks the general-and-peace line, shouts once, and is the exact actor who descends.

下座 s1 o13: Complete Record of Chan Master Juelang Daosheng of Tianjie (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄), Juelang Daosheng's own record. The lay questioner introduced only as Huang Gong is the exact speaker of “Please step down”; all six rungs leave his personal name unresolved. Juelang Daosheng answers and is the intended descender, not the actor of the request.

下座 s2 o1: Complete Collection of the Five Lamps (五燈全書), Dengfeng Huayan Yu section. Censor Wang, identified only by surname and office after all six rungs, is the exact questioner who contrasts the upper and lower seats; Huayan Yu gives the response.
